repositories.name: Crawl4AI (Async Playwright)
repositories.primary_metric: Async Playwright LLM web crawler with BM25 Fit-Markdown stripping 96% of boilerplate DOM tokens
repositories.production_tradeoff: Headless Chromium browser pool requires dedicated CPU cores and 1.5GB RAM per concurrent worker

repositories.name: Firecrawl (LLM Scraper & Crawler)
repositories.primary_metric: Turnkey /scrape, /crawl, /map, and LLM schema extraction API converting websites to clean Markdown
repositories.production_tradeoff: Cloud managed API credits or self-hosted multi-container Docker cluster with Redis & Playwright

repositories.name: ScrapeGraphAI (LLM Graph Scraper)
repositories.primary_metric: Direct graph-based LLM scraping pipeline using local Ollama or cloud models for zero-CSS extraction
repositories.production_tradeoff: LLM inference cost and token latency on every page extraction without cached CSS selectors

repositories.name: Jina Reader (Prefix Proxy)
repositories.primary_metric: Converts any URL to clean LLM-friendly markdown by simply prepending r.jina.ai/ with zero setup
repositories.production_tradeoff: Public endpoint rate limits or self-hosted Node.js Puppeteer proxy deployment

repositories.name: Spider (Rust Multi-Threaded)
repositories.primary_metric: Ultra-fast multi-threaded Rust web crawler and scraper indexing 10,000+ pages/second with tiny RAM usage
repositories.production_tradeoff: Dynamic JavaScript SPAs require optional headless browser bridge rather than native HTTP parsing
